# m.stocks.short_volume

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Daily short sale volume of US-listed stocks, one row per ticker and trading day.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.short_volume(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol` and `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; None, the default, for every ticker. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first trading day. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last trading day. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"short_volume_ratio_gte": 50}`. Keys: `short_volume_ratio`, `short_volume_ratio_any_of`, `short_volume_ratio_gt`, `short_volume_ratio_gte`, `short_volume_ratio_lt`, `short_volume_ratio_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Short Volume (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The primary ticker symbol for the stock." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read for the dataset's asset class. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `AdfShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported via the Alternative Display Facility (ADF), excluding exempt volume. |
| `AdfShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume reported via ADF that was marked as exempt. |
| `Date` | String | The date of trade activity reported in the format YYYY-MM-DD |
| `ExemptVolume` | double | Portion of short volume that was marked as exempt from regulation SHO. |
| `NasdaqCarteretShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Carteret facility, excluding exempt volume. |
| `NasdaqCarteretShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from Nasdaq Carteret that was marked as exempt. |
| `NasdaqChicagoShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Chicago facility, excluding exempt volume. |
| `NasdaqChicagoShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from Nasdaq Chicago that was marked as exempt. |
| `NonExemptVolume` | double | Portion of short volume that was not exempt from regulation SHO (i.e., short_volume - exempt_volume). |
| `NyseShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from NYSE facilities, excluding exempt volume. |
| `NyseShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from NYSE facilities that was marked as exempt. |
| `ShortVolume` | double | Total number of shares sold short across all venues for the ticker on the given date. |
| `ShortVolumeRatio` | double | The percentage of total volume that was sold short. Calculated as (short_volume / total_volume) * 100. |
| `TotalVolume` | double | Total reported volume across all venues for the ticker on the given date. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together, in one REST page, share it. It isn't Massive's time, and it isn't monotonic. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
